cipher.summary: Fixed wig-try-on's image-fetch abort misclassification (WIG_TRY_ON_ABORTED instead of WIG_IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED) and added a missing-XAI_API_KEY preflight to meechie-studio-text/tools/chat-interpretation before rate-limit quota is charged, reproducing each route's existing response shape exactly.
cipher.risks: No live-traffic validation of the "key present" path for any of the three new preflights (no XAI_API_KEY in this environment); the three preflights are independently implemented per pipeline rather than shared, a deliberate scope tradeoff documented above.
